content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00180 The RTE shall implement a range check in the receiving path of a particular signal if the handleOutOfRange is defined at the ISignalProps and has any value other than none . In this case all receivers of the specific ISignal on that ECU receive the value after the range check was applied.
